{{Otheruses|Starfighter Command}}
'''New Republic Starfighter Command''', sometimes simply referred to as '''Starfighter Command''', was the entity of the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic]] associated with [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter-craft units]]. It is unknown if it was a separate branch from the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]] or the Army.

Officers of Starfighter Command used a mix of Navy and Army ranks, including [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]], [[Major/Legends|Major]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]], and [[General/Legends|General]]. The lowest rank in Starfighter Command was [[Flight officer/Legends|Flight officer]], which was equivalent to a Navy [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]].

The famous starfighter unit [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] served in Starfighter Command.

Notable [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] within Starfighter Command include [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] and [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm]].
